Las Vegas, in 2015, was arguably the biggest sports city in America without a major sports team. By 2028, there could be an NHL, NFL, WNBA and an NBA franchise all within the City of Sin.
So why the very sudden change of heart?

This is a story of how America's major sports once viewed Las Vegas as untouchable because they believed gambling and sporting integrity could not coexist. But now they see the two as “reinforcing” one another.
Written by Ryan Baldi, illustrated by Marco Bevilacqua.
